business_summary: Beijing Jingyeda Technology Co.,Ltd. provides information transmission, software, and information technology services in China. The company offers smart education and campus solutions to universities, primary and secondary schools, as well as examination institutions. It also develops Starry Sky Education Big Model and Teaching Big Data System, that provides lesson preparation, delivery, learning, evaluation, teaching research, and management. In addition, it offers Galaxy 3000 series AI smart classroom and educational training services. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
